def main():
    sa = sys.argv
    # Custom bulk mode: python rosetta.py bulk README_SOURCE.md en es fr de ...
    if len(sa) > 1 and sa[1] == "bulk":
        src_file = sa[2]
        start_code = sa[3]
        target_codes = sa[4:]

        output_file = "README.md"

        if not os.path.exists(src_file):
            print(f"Error: {src_file} not found.")
            sys.exit(1)

        with open(src_file, "r") as f:
            source_content = f.read()

        current_rosetta = ""
        translated_sections = []

        for code in target_codes:
            print(f"Translating to {code}...")
            trans_text, rosetta_part = readme_md_translate(src_file, start_code, code)
            translated_sections.append(trans_text)
            # Update rosetta table
            if not current_rosetta:
                current_rosetta = rosetta_part
            else:
                # Add just the new row to existing table
                current_rosetta = forge_stone("", start_code, code, current_rosetta)

        with open(output_file, "w") as out:
            out.write(current_rosetta)
            out.write("\n")
            out.write(source_content)
            for section in translated_sections:
                out.write("\n\n<!-- toc -->\n\n")
                out.write(section)

        print(f"Bulk translation complete! {output_file} created.")
        sys.exit(0)

    # Legacy mode
    if len(sa) == 4:
        start_code, end_code, md_text = sa[1], sa[2], sa[3]
    elif len(sa) == 2 and sa[1] == "translate":
        # Handle the case described in README: readme-rosetta translate --input ...
        # For now, let's just make it a bit more flexible or stick to legacy
        print("Usage: readme-rosetta bulk <src> <from> <to1> <to2> ...")
        print("   or: readme-rosetta <from> <to> <src>")
        sys.exit(1)
    else:
        start_code, end_code, md_text = "en", "es", "README_SOURCE.md"

    if not os.path.exists(md_text):
        print(f"Error: {md_text} not found.")
        sys.exit(1)

    print(f"Translating {md_text} from {start_code} to {end_code}...")
    translated_text, rosetta_table = readme_md_translate(md_text, start_code, end_code)

    with open("README.md", "w") as nrm:
        nrm.write(rosetta_table)
        with open(md_text, "r") as og:
            nrm.write(og.read())
        nrm.write("\n<!-- toc -->\n")
        nrm.write(translated_text)

    print("Done! See README.md")




if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()
